title: ESG2WIN: ESG Reporting as a Competitiveness Tool for SMEs and Mid-caps
label: Applied research project
description: Reframe ESG reporting from a compliance obligation into a practical decision-making tool for effective management of environmental, social, and governance areas, with AI support.
researchDesign: Research report on ESG in SMEs and mid-caps using triangulation of desk research, qualitative research, and quantitative research.
researchThemes: Motivations and barriers related to ESG reporting
Standardisation of criteria and measurement methods
Voluntary and externally driven ESG reporting
Pressures from customers, supply chains, banks, financial institutions, and regulation
Limited human resources and ESG knowledge
ESG data availability, quality, and reliability
softwareComponent: Minimum viable software solution for ESG management and reporting, including document upload, questionnaire, ERP integration, AI integration, structured ESG data, development scenarios, projections, ROI on ESG measures, and scores in individual ESG areas.
benefits: Insights into SME and mid-cap behaviour
Support for ESG policy and regulatory tools
Stronger connection between public administration and businesses
